celebi.pythonPath.description: Path to Python interpreter. If empty, auto-detects from virtualenv or uses 'python3'

celebi.virtualenvPath.description: Path to Python virtualenv directory (e.g., /path/to/.venv). Auto-detected if empty

celebi.packagePath.description: Optional: Path to CelebiChrono package (if not in Python path)

celebi.diteServerUrl.description: DITE server URL used when the project has no .celebi/hosts.json
